en-US.longDescription: HXSmart is the first intelligent investment assistant launched by Hithink Royalflush in the field of machine learning and artificial intelligence. With big data and powerful natural language processing technology, HXSmart aims to provide stockholders with stock selection, stock diagnosis, intelligent Q&A and other services. The more you communicate with HXSmart, the more it understands your preferences and habits, and the more efficiently it can help you solve problems.
en-US.name: 同花顺问财

zh-CN.longDescription: “问财” 是同花顺发布的全国首款智能投资助手，是同花顺在机器学习和人工智能领域方面的尝试。“问财” 利用大数据以及强大的自然语言处理技术，致力于为股民提供选股、诊股、智能问答等服务。你与“问财”交流的越多，就越了解你的喜好和习惯，就越能高效的帮你解决问题。
zh-CN.name: 同花顺问财
